verses.1: To David, blessed be Jehovah! May His teachings make my hands strong for battle.
verses.2: My grace and kindness are upon me; they lift me up from my downward state. They protect me, and I am safe among my people.
verses.3: YHWH is not like any human being; He was known even before man existed, and He was considered as such.
verses.4: Man, like a candle, his days were like a mirror that reflected his flaws.
verses.5: May the LORD, who has raised you up, descend from the mountains and make us successful.
verses.6: In the midst of chaos and confusion, let them be sent away from your presence.
verses.7: Send your hands away from me, from the power of my enemies. Save me from the many waters that come from the children of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.8: Their mouths speak lies, and their right hands are used for deceit.
verses.9: God, I will sing a new song to you. I will sing it in your honor.
verses.10: He who gives relief to kings who have exiled David from his kingdom.
verses.11: Save me from the hands of those foreign nations whose mouths speak lies, and whose right hands are full of deceit.
verses.12: Our children, who are like plants that grow from their roots, will become like flowers that bloom from the seeds of the building.
verses.13: We are filled with fruits from one season to another. Our crops grow in all our fields.
verses.14: Our nostrils are filled with smoke; there is no fresh air, and there is no sound in our streets.
verses.15: The people who have been destroyed by God’s judgment. The people who are under God’s wrath.
